about.section1Title: Elevating the value of Vietnamese avocado
about.section1P1: Aloo's story began in 2013 with a desire to create quality, nutritious products from local fruit. The founder saw avocado as a superfood with outstanding value whose potential was still underexplored.
about.section1P2: By 2023, under CEO Nguyen Thi Hoang Phuong — Aloo Quy Nhon Co., Ltd. — the brand broke through with synchronized investment in business model, professional operations and elevated customer experience.
about.section2P1: The biggest challenge was securing a stable supply of fresh avocado. As a seasonal crop, quality varies with weather and region. Aloo tightened input control, rigorously selected growing areas and standardized processing and storage.
about.section2P2: Serious commitment to "real fresh avocado" set Aloo apart. Amid industrial food trends, the natural, green flavor of avocado won customers' trust completely.
about.section2ImageCaption: Real fresh avocado · Green · Clean · Delicious
about.section3P1: As of 2026, Aloo operates stores in two bustling coastal tourism cities: Quy Nhon and Nha Trang. We keep expanding the menu with creative flavors and the flexible AlooBike model.
about.section3AudienceText:
Students · Families · Tourists
From just 20,000 VND — fresh avocado ice cream for everyone.
